input.title: Women's Sewing – I Have Enough Fabric. (I Don't.) Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

I HAVE ENOUGH FABRIC. (I DON'T.) is the sewing hoodie for the sewist whose stash says otherwise, worn in the sewing room, at the fabric store and at the guild meeting, or given by family who has seen the closet.

I HAVE ENOUGH stacks over FABRIC. across the top and (I DON'T.) fills the bottom in huge slab capitals. Between them a 1950s woman threads a needle at a vintage sewing machine, hemmed in by two wobbly towers of folded fabric in prints and solids, with a pincushion and scissors on the table.

Navy carries cream and coral lettering with a cream edge around the scene; Sand gets deep teal and brick red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this sewing hoodie warm enough for sewing-room days and cool evenings?
Yes. The I Have Enough Fabric. (I Don't.) hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for long hours at the machine, cool sewing rooms and guild meetings.

How does the I Have Enough Fabric. (I Don't.) hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a sewist?
It is a natural one. Every sewist has said she has enough fabric while holding another bolt, so it lands with quilters, guild friends and the family who has seen the closet. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the sewing scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the I Have Enough Fabric. (I Don't.) hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
